shortBulletSummary: Geopolitical tensions eased as Trump paused Iran strike threat, leading to a Bitcoin rebound.
Over $500M in crypto liquidations occurred during recent market dip, primarily hitting long positions.
Crypto Fear & Greed Index sits at 37 ('Fear'), reflecting investor uncertainty.
Rising oil prices, higher Treasury yields, and a strong USD continue to create macro headwinds for crypto.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced significant outflows of $487.1M on Oct 7, signaling lower institutional demand.
